_note: Config for tools/build-demo.mjs — the embeddable team WIDGET (apps/fan pages/Widget.html, served at ?view=widget&team=…&sport=…&level=…&gender=…&show=…&title=… by Router.js doGet, for Google Sites iframes). Run from the repo root AFTER build-logic.mjs: node tools/build-demo.mjs demos/talon-hub/build.widget.json.
replace:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Talon Hub — HCS Athletics</title>
<script src="fan-logic.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
<!-- Embeddable team widget

(function () { var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search), g = function (k) { return String(q.get(k) || ''); }; return { team: g('team'), sport: g('sport'), level: g('level'), gender: g('gender'), show: g('show'), title: g('title'), execUrl: 'fan.html' }; })()

_replaceNotes.wrapper: Widget.html is a fragment with its own <style>; the first two replacements wrap it into a document (and load fan-logic.js) so build-demo.mjs can inject the shim before </head>.
_replaceNotes.paramsJson: The server builds WIDGET_PARAMS from the request's query string (Router.js doGet). The demo does the same in the browser, so widget.html?sport=GSOC&level=V filters exactly like the live ?view=widget URL. execUrl (ScriptApp.getService().getUrl() — the live /exec) becomes fan.html; the widget appends ?view=schedule, which fan.html ignores.
